tool_args.rationale: The seven measurements show a monotone-concave response and measurable gradient dependence, with no high-gradient avalanche signature. Fit the proposed four-parameter smooth law numerically to all rows and confirm it; the previous attempt failed because its predictor referenced an undefined global training-row variable, so this version stores fitted parameters directly.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Seven paid observations already span u_now and s_grad, and the prior failure was a code-scoping bug rather than a data-identifiability issue.
The highest observed gradient is 2.35, below the cited avalanche threshold; spending for a different regime is not warranted for the stated forecast.
It cannot represent the measured response changes across s_grad, which varies independently of u_now.
The observed u_now response is monotone concave and is more naturally represented by saturation plus a root contribution; the available data do not motivate another probe.
